VERSION 1.2.42026-10-13

## Mythforge - Beyond the Horizon-1.2.4.zip

 [Official release notes ↗](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mythforge-beyond-the-horizon/files/9152368) 

Added Mods Akashic Tome Patchouli Galosphere Galosphere: Spellbooks Born in Chaos Cataclysm of Chaos Loot Integrations: Born in Chaos ANARCHY Minibosses Create: Mechanical Botany More RPG Classes - Skill Tree Reliquified Artifacts Ars Sable Create Collision Fix Sphere Projector SilverLib Added Datapacks Hostile Neural Networks: Extra Data Models Anti Enderman Grief One Player Sleep Supplementaries Compat Cataclysm Compat Removed Mods Abyssal Ocean / Hadal Depths Removed an incompatible MoreRelics addon introduced during development. Progression & Guides Removed the main quest progression and its old rewards. Removed automatic quest-book handouts. Removed quest requirements from Refuge travel. Updated Refuge NPCs with simple greetings and travel options. Players now receive an Akashic Tome containing 17 mod guides. Fixed the AE2 and Spectrum guides inside the Tome. Fixed blank guidebook entries and added clearer book names. Advanced Peripherals and Mine Cells no longer give separate books automatically. Their guides remain in the Tome. Gacha Changes Wardens now reward Minor Gamba tokens. Kept the 30-minute reward cooldown. Updated token names, descriptions, and tooltips. Removed the old custom tokens and Refuge gacha machine. Fixes & Improvements Fixed &ldquo;Second Chances&rdquo; and &ldquo;Going Up?&rdquo; unlocking when unrelated blocks were placed. Removed the overlapping Accessories shortcut from the inventory. Disabled the Create Aeronautics Structures Telegram welcome message. Disabled the CSC whitelist reminder. Discovery traders now disappear after 40 minutes of loaded time. Enabled obstacle avoidance for Discovery aircraft and patrols. Improved claim protection and limited excessive chunk loading. Restricted selected capture mechanics, remote access features, and problematic items. Updated Reliquified Artifacts to resolve its compatibility crash. Updated numerous existing mods, including ModernFix, Quark, BetterEnd, Ice and Fire, and several RPG Series addons. Pack Cleanup Removed unused quest scripts and old campaign files. Removed leftover configs from uninstalled mods. Cleaned out obsolete settings, temporary files, and old backups. Disabled the unused KubeJS web server.

VERSION 1.2.02026-10-03

## Mythforge\_1.2.0.zip

 [Official release notes ↗](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mythforge-beyond-the-horizon/files/9042597) 

Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon - Update from 1.0.4.3 Main changes Replaced the previous quest book with a WIP notice while quests undergo further development. Added a custom main menu with layered animated artwork and updated branding. Added the Refuge dimension, custom NPCs, dialogue, and protection scripts. Disabled the automatic starting class scroll. Changed the recommended RAM allocation from 10 GB to 8 GB. Gameplay adjustments Disabled Nameless Trinkets crafting. Disabled the Illuminati Pet&rsquo;s item-generation ability. Disabled the End Portal and Juggernaut pets and removed their crafting recipes. Updated RPG equipment and spell-scroll loot settings. Updated configuration files for several mods. Added mods Create: Aeroworks Create: Deep Seas Create: Dragons Plus AEInfinityBooster RPG Style More Weapons Sablewaves EMI Autocrafting Better Advanced Tooltips Easy NPC, Easy NPC: Core, and Easy NPC: Config UI More Quest Types FancyMenu, Konkrete, and Melody KubeJS and Rhino WorldEdit and WorldEdit Items Removed mods Legendary Monsters Legendary Monsters Create Compat Legendary Spellbooks Nera Jadis: Arcane Arsenal Sea Myths FramedBlocks Mod updates Updated 30 mods, including Ice and Fire Community Edition, Spell Engine, the RPG Series class mods, Create: Interiors, Create: Flight Control, Create Aeronautics Discovery, Gadgets & Gizmos, Abyssal Ocean, Lootr, and several libraries and compatibility addons. Updating an existing installation Back up your world before updating. Removed mods&rsquo; blocks, items, and entities may be lost, including existing FramedBlocks builds. Replace the old quest folder instead of merging it so removed quests do not remain.

## Mythforge-1.0.3.zip

 [Official release notes ↗](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mythforge-beyond-the-horizon/files/8915162) 

What's new Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon 1.0.3 A small maintenance update focused on server compatibility and making the pack easier to host. 357 mods. Updated Marium's Soulslike Weaponry &rarr; 1.4.8 Includes additional bug fixes and compatibility improvements Improves stability when running through Sinytra Connector Fixes a server crash involving certain Forge mods Server Files Added an official server pack for Mythforge Server owners can now download the matching server files for this version instead of building the server manually Client and server files are aligned for 1.0.3

VERSION 1.0.22026-09-18

## Mythforge-1.0.2.zip

 [Official release notes ↗](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mythforge-beyond-the-horizon/files/8908176) 

What's new Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon 1.0.2 Long-distance exploration gets a major visual upgrade, alongside new music systems, loot notifications and compatibility updates. 357 mods (up from 352). Added Distant Horizons - adds level-of-detail terrain rendering, allowing the world to remain visible far beyond Minecraft's normal render distance Loot Journal: Pickup Notifier - displays newly collected items and loot without needing to constantly check your inventory Maestro - dynamic music framework for expanding and controlling Minecraft's soundtrack Maestro: Overture - expanded soundtrack and music experience built for Maestro Fragmentum - supporting library required by the new Obscuria mods YetAnotherConfigLib - configuration library required by the new additions Updated Legendary Monsters &rarr; 2.2.3 Streams Reflowing &rarr; 2.13.7 These updates also bring additional fixes and compatibility improvements for the pack's Create and Sable-heavy environment.

VERSION 1.0.12026-09-15

## Mythforge-1.0.1.zip

 [Official release notes ↗](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mythforge-beyond-the-horizon/files/8887983) 

\## Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon 1.0.1 Computers and automation join the pack, plus a round of mod updates. \*\*352 mods\*\* (up from 347). ### Added - \*\*CC: Tweaked\*\* - programmable in-game computers, turtles and peripherals - \*\*CC: Sable\*\* - connects CC: Tweaked to the Sable physics engine, so you can script your airships directly - \*\*Advanced Peripherals\*\* - extended peripheral set for CC: Tweaked - \*\*Create: Avionics\*\* - computer-controlled flight systems - \*\*Minor Gamba\*\* - two uncraftable gambling machines: a gacha machine that outputs any item in the game, and a simple double-or-nothing Together these mean an airship can now be flown by a Lua program instead of a player. ### Updated - Aeronautics Player Tilt &rarr; 0.2.0 - Ars 'n Spells &rarr; 3.3.4 - Azimuth API &rarr; 1.4.8 - Create: Bits 'n' Bobs &rarr; 2.3.5 - Create: Creating Space &rarr; 1.7.22 - Create: Flight Control &rarr; 0.7.2 - Moog's Structure Lib &rarr; 3.3.1
